name: Hakkenden
source:
Washing blood with blood, in an era when people wage wars earnestly for a small plot of land, the [i]Sengoku[/i] period.

Kanto region, in the small mountains, even though autumn has ended for some time, the crimson leaves still blossom, the blooming and falling of these crimson leaves seemingly continue eternally.

At first, everyone wonders, but their suspicion gradually fades. After a while, the influential people at the time name this era "Kowa".

With the leaves slowly spreading throughout the region, a small cult worshiping the crimson leaves, calling themselves [i]Shuukyou[/i], has risen among the people.

Time passes, and it is now the 18th year of [i]Kowa[/i]. When the hapless fates of those who live in this harsh world intertwine, the end of an era begins.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1237545]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
以血洗血，为争夺一小片土地而拼死征战的时代，[i]战国[/i]。

关东地区的某片山间，明明秋天早已过去，朱红的叶子却依旧繁盛，仿佛永无止境地生长、飘落。

起初，人们都为此感到惊讶，渐渐地却不再怀疑。又过了一段时间，当权者将这个时代命名为“红和”。

红叶慢慢蔓延到整个关东地区，民众之中也兴起了一种崇拜红叶的小规模信仰，自称[i]朱教[/i]。

时光流转，如今已是[i]红和[/i]十八年。生于乱世之人的坎坷命运相互交织之时，一个时代的终结就此开始。

[译编自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1237545]Getchu[/url]]
